I have a piece at the Committee for the Economic Development of Australia [blog](https://www.ceda.com.au/Digital-hub/Blogs/CEDA-Blog/April-2020/What-COVID-19-means-for-Australian-productivity) on the implications of the current pandemic for Australian labour productivity based on my recent report for USSC.

David Uren also writes up my report for the Australian Strategic Policy Institute blog, [The Strategist](https://www.aspistrategist.org.au/economic-recovery-from-coronavirus-means-resisting-the-urge-to-back-away-from-globalisation/).
